description: This file contains Jest unit tests for a React web application, specifically testing campaign-related UI interactions such as toggling platforms, launching campaigns, and asset selection behavior. It mocks local storage, uses react-testing-library for DOM testing, and simulates user events and timing.

methods.name: setAuth(role = 'editor')
methods.description: Sets mock authentication data in localStorage with a specified user role (default is 'editor')
